guard: The runtime askHost entrypoint forwards auth.managerInstanceId to resolveService so instance-scoped manager-caller credentials can resolve their pinned instance without hitting broker permission denial on class routes.

mutations.name: runtime askHost omits instanceId when resolving manager
mutations.expectRed: runtime askHost connects to instance-scoped manager with valid managerInstanceId
mutations.cell: runtime askHost connects to instance-scoped manager with valid managerInstanceId
mutations.note: A manager-caller credential holds permission only for its pinned instance route (ep.inst.manager.<IID>.describe). Omitting instanceId causes resolveService to default to class route ep.one.manager.describe, which the native broker refuses with permission-denied.
